subtopics.label: Traumatic Brain Injury Rehabilitation and Recovery
subtopics.description: Research on functional, cognitive, and neurological recovery following traumatic brain injury (TBI), including inpatient rehabilitation outcomes, neuroimaging biomarkers, deep brain stimulation, and assessment tools for pediatric and adult TBI populations.
subtopics.short_description: Functional, cognitive, and neurological recovery after TBI, including neuroimaging biomarkers and deep brain stimulation.

subtopics.label: Stroke Rehabilitation and Motor Recovery
subtopics.description: Research on post-stroke rehabilitation outcomes including motor recovery, functional connectivity reorganization, cognitive deficits, caregiver support, and predictive biomarkers for recovery following ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke.
subtopics.short_description: Motor recovery, functional connectivity reorganization, and predictive biomarkers following ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke.

subtopics.label: Disorders of Consciousness and Severe Brain Injury
subtopics.description: Research on assessment, ethics, and intervention for patients with disorders of consciousness (DoC) including cognitive motor dissociation, covert cognition detection via EEG, legal rights, and ethical frameworks for severe brain injury care.
subtopics.display_name: Disorders of Consciousness & Severe Brain Injury
subtopics.short_description: Assessment, ethics, and intervention for patients with disorders of consciousness, including covert cognition detection via EEG.

subtopics.label: Dysphagia Assessment and Swallowing Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on evaluation and treatment of swallowing disorders, including FEES-based assessment tools (VASES, DIGEST), respiratory-swallow coordination, bolus characteristics, orofacial strength measurement, and dysphagia in neurological conditions such as Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Evaluation and treatment of swallowing disorders, including FEES-based tools and dysphagia in neurological conditions.

subtopics.label: Cognitive Training and Functional Skills in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Research on computerized cognitive training programs, functional skills assessment and training (CFSAT), adherence prediction using machine learning, and technology-based interventions to improve everyday functioning in older adults with and without cognitive impairment.
subtopics.short_description: Computerized cognitive training and technology-based interventions to improve everyday functioning in older adults.

subtopics.label: Post-Acute COVID-19 Sequelae and Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on the neuropsychiatric, cognitive, and functional consequences of COVID-19 infection including long COVID brain fog, post-intensive care syndrome, rehabilitation interventions, and digital tools for cognitive recovery in COVID-19 survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Neuropsychiatric, cognitive, and functional consequences of COVID-19, including long COVID brain fog and recovery interventions.

subtopics.label: Traumatic Spinal Injury Management in Low- and Middle-Income Countries
subtopics.description: Research on presentation, surgical management, neurological outcomes, complications, and post-discharge follow-up of traumatic spinal cord injuries in East Africa and other low- and middle-income country settings.
subtopics.display_name: Spinal Cord Injury in Low-Income Settings
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management, neurological outcomes, and post-discharge follow-up for traumatic spinal injuries in East Africa and LMICs.

subtopics.label: Multiple Sclerosis Disability and Neuroimaging Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research on structural and functional connectivity biomarkers of disability in multiple sclerosis, including lesion-based disconnectivity, dynamic functional connectivity, corneal nerve fiber loss, and cognitive outcomes with disease-modifying therapy.
subtopics.short_description: Structural and functional connectivity biomarkers of disability in MS, including lesion-based disconnectivity and cognitive outcomes.

subtopics.label: Chronic Pain Management and Psychosocial Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on biopsychosocial approaches to chronic pain including peer-delivered cognitive behavioral therapy, positive affect interventions, digital self-management tools, pain beliefs, discrimination, and pain outcomes in diverse populations including older adults and torture survivors.
subtopics.short_description: Biopsychosocial approaches to chronic pain, including CBT, digital self-management tools, and outcomes in diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Voice Disorders, Laryngology, and Communication Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on assessment and rehabilitation of voice disorders including gender-affirming voice modification, outcomes following laryngeal surgery, telehealth delivery of voice care, voice injury in performers, and speech-language pathology practice.
subtopics.short_description: Assessment and rehabilitation of voice disorders, including gender-affirming voice modification and telehealth delivery of voice care.

subtopics.label: Assistive Technology and Disability Access
subtopics.description: Research on access to and usability of assistive technology for individuals with disabilities, including children with acquired brain injury, older adults with cognitive impairments, individuals with dexterity impairments, and automatic speech recognition for deaf and hard-of-hearing users.
subtopics.short_description: Access and usability of assistive technology for individuals with disabilities, including speech recognition for deaf and hard-of-hearing users.

subtopics.label: Disability Policy, Ethics, and Health Equity
subtopics.description: Research on disability rights frameworks, health equity, bioethics, and policy issues affecting people with disabilities including crisis standards of care, ableism in bioethics, intellectual and developmental disabilities, and interagency coordination for co-occurring conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Disability rights, bioethics, and health equity policy affecting people with functional impairments and developmental conditions.

subtopics.label: Osseointegrated Prostheses and Amputee Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on osseointegrated prosthetic implants for lower limb amputees, including cost-benefit analysis, infection management, surgical considerations such as concurrent thigh lifts, and functional outcomes compared to conventional prostheses.
subtopics.short_description: Osseointegrated prosthetic implants for lower limb amputees, including cost-benefit analysis and functional outcomes.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Brain Injury Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Research on cognitive and functional recovery during inpatient rehabilitation for children with traumatic brain injury, including delirium screening, cognitive assessment tools, neuroimaging predictors, and access to assistive technology in pediatric neurorehabilitation.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive and functional recovery in children with TBI, including delirium screening and neuroimaging predictors during inpatient rehabilitation.

subtopics.label: Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation and Sports Medicine
subtopics.description: Research on rehabilitation of musculoskeletal conditions including shoulder pain in wheelchair users, osteoarthritis interventions, sports-related concussion, peer coaching for joint replacement, and exercise-based interventions for low back pain.
subtopics.short_description: Rehabilitation of musculoskeletal conditions including shoulder pain, osteoarthritis, sports concussion, and exercise-based interventions.

subtopics.label: Sensory Recovery and Neurotization in Breast Reconstruction
subtopics.description: Research on sensory outcomes following mastectomy and breast reconstruction, including neurotized DIEP flap techniques, nerve coaptation strategies, and the impact of chemotherapy/radiation on breast sensation and quality of life.
subtopics.short_description: Sensory outcomes following mastectomy and breast reconstruction, including neurotized DIEP flap techniques and nerve coaptation strategies.

subtopics.label: Lumbar Spine Surgery Outcomes and Techniques
subtopics.description: Studies examining surgical approaches for lumbar spine conditions including minimally invasive TLIF, direct lateral interbody fusion, cauda equina syndrome, and degenerative disc disease, with focus on clinical and functional outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical approaches for lumbar spine conditions including minimally invasive TLIF, lateral interbody fusion, and degenerative disc disease.

subtopics.label: Cervical and Thoracic Spine Surgery and Neurological Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of cervical and cervicothoracic spine pathology, including fusion techniques, adjacent segment disease, atlanto-axial osteoarthritis, and neurological outcomes following spinal cord and nerve compression.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of cervical and cervicothoracic spine pathology, including fusion techniques and neurological outcomes after cord compression.

subtopics.label: Social Skills Interventions and Autism Spectrum Disorder
subtopics.description: Research on behavioral and social skills interventions for children and youth with autism spectrum disorder, including group-based programs, caregiver-mediated naturalistic developmental behavioral interventions, and diagnosis disclosure practices.
subtopics.short_description: Behavioral and social skills programs for children with autism spectrum disorder, including caregiver-mediated naturalistic interventions.

subtopics.label: Physical Function, Cognition, and Pain in Older Adults with HIV
subtopics.description: Studies examining the interrelationships among physical function, cognitive performance, pain, inflammation, and mood in older adults living with HIV, including gait speed as a functional biomarker.
subtopics.display_name: Physical Function & Cognition in Older Adults with HIV
subtopics.short_description: Interrelationships among physical function, cognition, pain, and inflammation in older adults living with HIV.

subtopics.label: Orofacial and Respiratory Muscle Strength Assessment
subtopics.description: Research validating low-cost and portable measurement tools for tongue, lip, cheek, and respiratory muscle strength, including comparisons with gold-standard devices for clinical and research applications.
subtopics.short_description: Validation of portable tools for measuring tongue, lip, cheek, and respiratory muscle strength in clinical and research settings.

subtopics.label: Sleep Interventions and Wearable Monitoring in Parkinson's Disease
subtopics.description: Research on non-pharmacological interventions for sleep disturbance in Parkinson's disease, including light therapy trials, and the use of wearable devices for monitoring motor and non-motor symptoms in clinical care.
subtopics.display_name: Sleep & Wearable Monitoring in Parkinson's Disease
subtopics.short_description: Non-pharmacological sleep interventions and wearable device monitoring of motor and non-motor symptoms in Parkinson's disease.

subtopics.label: Telehealth and Remote Care Delivery in Rehabilitation
subtopics.description: Studies examining the feasibility, effectiveness, and accessibility of telehealth and tele-paramedicine for delivering rehabilitation and geriatric care, including fall risk reduction and social skills programs delivered remotely.
subtopics.short_description: Feasibility and effectiveness of telehealth and tele-paramedicine for delivering rehabilitation and geriatric care remotely.

subtopics.label: Cancer Rehabilitation and Neuro-Oncology Functional Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on rehabilitation outcomes in patients with brain tumors and cancer, including inpatient rehabilitation for glioblastoma, neurocognitive effects of meningiomas, spine tumor rehabilitation, and comprehensive survivorship care models.
subtopics.short_description: Rehabilitation outcomes in patients with brain tumors and cancer, including inpatient glioblastoma care and survivorship models.

subtopics.label: Intrathecal Drug Delivery and Neurostimulation Devices
subtopics.description: Research on implantable devices for spasticity and pain management, including intrathecal baclofen pump placement techniques, management of hypertonia in movement disorders, and MRI compatibility challenges with spinal cord stimulators.
subtopics.short_description: Implantable devices for spasticity and pain management, including intrathecal baclofen pumps and spinal cord stimulators.

subtopics.label: Fall Prevention and Risk Reduction in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Studies on fall risk factors and prevention strategies in older adults, including the role of polypharmacy, chronic kidney disease, benzodiazepine use post-stroke, and tele-paramedicine-based fall risk reduction programs.
subtopics.short_description: Fall risk factors and prevention strategies in older adults, including polypharmacy, chronic kidney disease, and tele-paramedicine programs.

subtopics.label: Neuropsychological Assessment in Neurosurgical and Acquired Brain Injury Contexts
subtopics.description: Research on cognitive and neuropsychological evaluation in neurosurgical settings, including assessment before and after brain tumor resection, colloid cyst surgery, and multicontext cognitive rehabilitation approaches for acquired brain injury.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive evaluation before and after brain tumor resection and multicontext cognitive rehabilitation for acquired brain injury.

subtopics.label: Myofascial Pain Assessment and Interventional Treatments
subtopics.description: Research on diagnosis and treatment of myofascial pain syndromes, including ultrasound-guided trigger point injection techniques, virtual reality as an adjunct therapy, and shoulder ultrasound reliability for musculoskeletal assessment.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and treatment of myofascial pain syndromes, including ultrasound-guided trigger point injections and virtual reality adjunct therapy.

subtopics.label: Hearing Loss, Communication, and Psychosocial Impact
subtopics.description: Studies on the functional and psychosocial consequences of hearing loss across populations, including cancer survivors, heart failure patients, and the emotional dimensions of audiological care.
subtopics.short_description: Functional and psychosocial consequences of hearing loss across populations, including cancer survivors and heart failure patients.

subtopics.label: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Training, Workforce, and Practice
subtopics.description: Research on PM&R residency training, clinical practice patterns, and workforce issues, including the impact of COVID-19 on resident clinical experience, sleep health documentation by physiatrists, and skilled nursing facility rehabilitation intensity.
subtopics.short_description: Residency training, clinical practice patterns, and workforce issues in physical medicine and rehabilitation.
